Two distinct exposures, one contained and one not. Contained: this diff edits a guardrail file directly, .claude/settings.json, and the existing guard did fire - piping an Edit payload naming that exact worktree path into .claude/hooks/protect-claude-config.sh returned permissionDecision "ask", so G4's "made deliberately harder" clause held for my edit. Not contained: the registrations at :110 and :174 wire the pointer swap (scripts/config/promote.mjs:36-47, whose renameSync at :45 relocates hooks/ and rules/ wholesale) and the release delete (scripts/config/release.mjs:79) to hooks the harness runs with no human in the loop. SPEC A section 5.4 records that protect-claude-config.sh covers ~/.claude/hooks/** but not ~/.claude/releases/<sha>/hooks/**, so neither reaches that guard. Mitigating but not disqualifying: converge is a no-op until a LIVE receipt exists (scripts/config/converge.mjs:48-51, asserted at scripts/config/tests/converge.test.mjs:179), so nothing can fire before cutover, and every test drives a mkdtemp sandbox from scripts/config/tests/_fixture.mjs. Recorded rather than excused.
